scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @coja/agent build && concurrently -k -n harness,server,web -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm --filter @coja/agent dev" "pnpm --filter @ayushporwal/coja dev" "pnpm --filter @coja/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @coja/agent build && pnpm --filter @coja/web build && pnpm --filter @ayushporwal/coja build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @coja/agent build && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @coja/agent typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
